pulls.title: Family-wide editorial + Overview + correctness pass (3 specs)
pulls.author: mcguinness
pulls.body:
## Summary

Three per-spec commits, one per draft, applying the editorial,
structural, and correctness work from the recent review cycle:

- **Migration profile** (`e6dcf25`) — IANA fixes (correct RFC 9493
  registry name; drop conflicting `sub_id` JWT re-registration),
  Token Exchange error-code split (`invalid_request` vs
  `invalid_grant` per RFC 7522 §2.1.1), scope-envelope rewrite per
  RFC 6749 §3.3, perspective-neutral `saml_idp_entity_id`
  description so Bridge and IdP can reuse it, `# Migration Binding
  Rationale` renamed to `# Binding and Issuance Model` for
  family-level consistency, `# Authorization and Consent Model`
  demoted to a subsection, padding strength aligned with RFC 7522
  §2.1, ACR-mapping passthrough rule disambiguated, `sub_id`
  release rules consolidated, Overview section added (RFC 6749
  §1.2 style with diagram and lettered steps), abstract trimmed
  from 27 to 17 lines, terminology additions, RFC 9396 / 9449 /
  8705 informative references added.

- **Bridge profile** (`4285b4b`) — NameID derivation collision fix
  (replaced non-injective `":"`-separated SHA-256 input with a
  JWS-style segment encoding using `base64url`-per-field and `.`
  separator, with a domain-separation tag for version headroom),
  `InResponseTo` MUST omit (not SHOULD) for unsolicited
  assertions, `aud`/`azp` validation consolidated and split by
  flow, Token Exchange error-code split per RFC 7522 §2.1.1,
  freshness window MUST (not SHOULD), `max_age=0` semantics
  clarified, `@AllowCreate` scoped to persistent NameID formats,
  transient NameID requires 128 bits of entropy, `state` value
  MUST be integrity-protected, `AuthnRequest/Scoping` rejected
  with `NoSupportedIDP` instead of silently ignored, Token
  Exchange session-termination gap addressed,
  `AudienceRestriction` no longer requires sole `Audience`,
  Overview section added (two diagrams for the two modes),
  abstract trimmed from 29 to 16 lines, four example
  contradictions fixed.

- **IdP-backed OP profile** (`31c9db5`) — `SameSite=Lax` cookie
  fallback fixed (the SAML Response ACS POST is cross-site and
  does not carry Lax cookies; mandates `SameSite=None;Secure`),
  `max_age > 0` enforcement added (OP MUST treat as upper bound
  on `AuthnInstant`), `RequestedAuthnContext/@Comparison`
  required per IdP-Binding policy (default SHOULD `"exact"`),
  AuthnRequest signing now binding-specific per SAML 2.0
  Bindings (detached for HTTP-Redirect, enveloped for
  HTTP-POST), multi-valued `AuthnContextClassRef` selection rule
  defined, NameID reassignment detection required, ID Token
  `exp` constraints versus SAML times specified, OIDC Session
  Management explicitly out of scope, Multi-IdP per-IdP issuer
  aliasing permitted with explicit metadata/JWKS/rotation rules,
  SLO `LogoutResponse` signing requirements specified, `OIDC RP
  Authorization` Security Considerations section now references
  the canonical authorization-basis rules instead of restating,
  `# Multi-IdP Deployments` trimmed to a reading-aid
  cross-reference, `## Issuance Authorization` renamed
  `## Authorization Basis and Release Policy`, Overview section
  added (RFC 6749 §1.2 style with diagram and lettered steps),
  Unicode arrow replaced with ASCII, `sub_id` correctly
  attributed to RFC 9493, terminology additions.

## Verification

- All three drafts build clean (`make clean && make`):
  kramdown-rfc → xml2rfc-txt → xml2rfc-html all OK.
- No stale cross-references: every anchor removed from `main`
  (`#migration-binding-rationale`, `#saml-key-material`,
  `#iana-security-event-identifier-formats`, `#flow-overview`)
  has zero remaining `{{xref}}` references in the branch.
- All IANA registry values used in the body of any draft remain
  registered or are appropriately deferred with editor's notes.
- Normative-keyword counts (MUST/SHOULD/MAY): Migration 466→417,
  Bridge 297→282, IdP 228→247 (IdP gains 19 normatives from new
  security/correctness rules; Migration and Bridge lose 49 / 15
  from editorial consolidation, all consolidations verified as
  intentional with no rule lost).

## Test plan

- [ ] Spot-check the Overview sections in all three drafts.
- [ ] Spot-check the IANA section in Migration (Subject
      Identifier Formats registration vs the old Security Event
      Identifier Formats heading).
- [ ] Verify the Bridge NameID derivation formula renders
      correctly in the published HTML/PDF.
- [ ] Verify the IdP `<->` ASCII arrow renders as intended in
      the published text output.
